policies.title: Spanish ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Official current guidance establishes visa-free short-visitor access for each listed Spanish ordinary-passport route.
conditions: VG: Spain is absent from the BVI Government's current list of visa-required nationalities. UA: EU citizens, including Spanish tourists, may stay up to three months without a visa. TN: Spanish citizens are visa-exempt for stays under 90 days.
This is the ordinary Spanish-passport short-visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, carrier rules, operational access and final admission.

policies.title: Spanish ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Official current guidance identifies a visitor visa issued at the border for each listed Spanish ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: the international-airport route is discretionary and MAEC also records a short-stay e-visa route. IQ: Baghdad International Airport issuance follows online application; the online filing does not itself establish an e-visa. KM: airport issuance. TM: Ashgabat airport issuance is limited to a ten-day visa and requires the Turkmen migration-authorised invitation.
This records the expressly stated border-issuance route only; purpose, document, carrier, route and final-admission conditions continue to apply.

conflicts.explanation: MAEC says the visa is issued on arrival at Baghdad International Airport after an online request; online filing is not electronic issuance.
MAEC expressly provides a ten-day Ashgabat-airport issuance route after Turkmen invitation approval.
